name: Mindstate Design Labs
long_description:
Mindstate Design Labs is building the closed-loop science & engineering stack for rational psychoactive effect design.

Our molecular-experience interface links molecular biology to the human psychopharmacodynamic profile to convert informal constructs like clarity, presence, or motivation into high-dimensional design targets.

Our clinical program is a sequence of human demonstrations that psychoactive effects can be decomposed, recombined, and synthesized. The first controlled study decomposed hallucinations from the broader hallucinogen profile; the next is designed to selectively upregulate aesthetic salience to treat anhedonia in major depressive disorder.

We’re progressively digitizing the molecular interface through which biology shapes what intelligence wants.
one_liner: Programmable biology company for psychoactive effect design

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Ex-VC, F500 M&A. Invested across frontier biology, software, and hardware; founded platforms in programmable genes, proteins, cells, and biological systems (AAV capsids, multispecific antibodies, TCRs, tumor microenvironment, etc.).
